## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `applemusic-v{{APP}}.zip` | The **Apple Music app for DeskThing**. In DeskThing, open **Apps**, add an app from a file, and pick this zip. |
| `now-playing-bridge-v{{EXT}}.zip` | The **Now Playing Bridge for DeskThing** browser extension. Unzip it into a folder you'll keep, then in `edge://extensions` or `chrome://extensions` turn on Developer mode → **Load unpacked** → pick that folder. |
| `latest.json` | Release info DeskThing reads to find updates. You don't need to download it. |

After updating, fully close and reopen the app on the Car Thing so it doesn't keep a cached copy. If the extension changed, click reload on its card in the extensions page, then reload your Apple Music tab.

Setup, controls and troubleshooting: see the [README](https://github.com/jayrez/AppleMusicThing#readme).
